title: Page 8
content_zh:
信封好后，他又取出另一张纸，写下半阙情诗——
美人如花隔云端。上有青冥之高天，下有渌水之波澜。天长路远魂飞苦，梦魂不到关山难。长相思，摧心肝。
这半阙诗为李白所写，段柯古本是想自作几首，但一读到最末两句，他便知道，这就是他欲倾诉的心情。
对他来说，每日醒来睡去，都是莫大的折磨。他每天都盼着信差过来，可同时也提心吊胆，深怕信里说的，是他无法承受的噩耗。
我心上记挂的人儿啊，你现在到底怎么样了？
他幽幽叹息，转而取出于伯先前写来的信，一字一句慢慢读，彷佛想藉此熟悉如意的一切。
前日信上写到，如意的形貌瘦削了许多。婢女说，看起来好像快消失了一样。
他闭起眼，满脸的痛苦。
定然是这样，算算，她已昏迷半月有余，不能嚼食，只能喂她喝些米粥，如此折腾，要她不憔悴也难。
当初抛下她独自来江州，这决定到底是对是错？
段柯古一望案上一角，那里正搁着如意亲笔题写的割烹子。他指掌轻轻抚挲，每翻一页，他心就多疼一会儿。
老天到底要折磨他们到什么地步才甘愿？他真想问问老天爷，明明幸福就已经在眼前，它为什么又狠心将它收回？
难道非得受此折磨，才能证明他的情深意切？
思及此，他脸上不禁流下两行热泪。
“大人。”师爷突然过来敲门。““小莲庄”捎来信了。”
“拿进来。”段柯古猛一吸气，掩袖抹一抹眼泪。
年约四十的师爷欠身走入，恭敬地将信箴送上，一边提醒：“大人，明儿您跟城里盐商见面的事，我都已经安排妥了……”
段柯古哼哈回应，压根儿没在听师爷说话，
“快！师爷——”他倏地大喊：“快帮我备车，我要赶到扬州去。”
师爷一脸惊讶。“等等等等……大人，您明天的宴席怎么办？下官都跟人说好了……”

“那宴席你出面就成了，五天，不，七天，我去扬州看一趟就回来。”段柯古边吩咐边往前走。“这几天府衙就麻烦你照顾了。”
“不是啊大人，”师爷追在身后。“这不是交给下官出面就成的问题……大人您听我说……您真的不能就这样丢下公务，您才刚到任不过几天……大人！”
师爷最后一声喊时，段柯古早跑得不见踪影。
开什么玩笑，跟城中大贾吃宴哪比得上见他的如意。
段柯古边跑边又掏出信箴细读。于伯信上写，昨儿夜里京城派来快马送来犀角粉，收到之后，他已立刻派人送上“还朴庵”。
于伯还写到，提亲队伍已经在途上，大概再三五天会到。
瞧信上日期，已经是两天前的事。他等不到明天收到如意的消息了，他现在、立刻、马上要去见她。
“于良，于良！”他边喊边奔进厢房。
于良就是于伯的儿子，在长安，一直是他帮忙打点照顾段柯古。
“大人。”于良赶忙跑过来听令。
“立刻帮我打点一个行囊，随便带几件衣裳就成。还有，要明后几天我的信到，你先帮我收着。”他一边说，一边七手八脚脱去袍服，换上轻便的白袍。还在系腰带时候，于良已经把一个蓝色布包打理好了。
“大人要上哪儿？”
“扬州。”他一把抓走于良手上包袱。“我不在的这几天，你就前前后后多帮我留心些。”
“是。大人一路顺风。”于良听其它随从提过，很清楚扬州那儿有谁在。
不等于良说完，段柯古早奔了出去。
就算尽量省去吃饭睡觉时间，从江州到扬州，少也要两天。
段柯古一路风尘仆仆、披星带月，就是为了早一点瞧一瞧心上人儿，是否安然无恙。
不知她身上的毒解清了没，现在可不可以下床走路说话了？也不知道于伯会不会忘记多帮她准备一点滋补的东西？于伯说她瘦了，现是瘦成什么模样了？[熱D書@吧#獨%家&制*作]
一大堆问题在他脑中盘旋，就等着他亲自过去探看解答。
他快马加鞭足足赶了一日半，终于，在傍晚时分抵达“小莲庄”。

“小莲庄”门房见马车上是谁，吓了一大跳。“段大人！”
“我回来了。”他说话的同时，人已经冲进敞开的红门里。
里边佣仆跑堂一见是他，欢迎声此起彼落。“是段大人！段大人回来了！”
于伯接到消息，忙从灶房那儿奔来。
“大人！您怎么跑回来啦？”
“我都收到信了，怎么可能不赶回来。”他一拍于伯肩膀。“如意她人呢？”
“在漱香小院，可是小姐她正在跟人家商议事情……”
于伯话还没说完，段柯古早撇下跑远了。
于伯笑看他家大人背影，也难怪他心急如焚，毕竟隔了半月未见了嘛。
“小姐，当心脚步。”
漱香小院里，婢女水盈慢慢将如意搀坐到主位上。
坐她面前的，是当年她唤“向叔”的二厨子孟向。一年前“小莲庄”易主，孟向头个辞工不干，是个颇有坚持，手艺也相当精湛的好厨子。
说来，如意的厨艺，一半也是孟向所教。
瞧她孱弱样，孟向忍不住问：“你没事吧？听人说陆明那家伙对你下了毒……”
如意点头。“谢向叔关心，如意好多了。”
传闻中珍稀的犀角粉果真能解鸩毒，京城派来快马一到，明彗法师立刻喂她服下，隔天一早她人就醒了。
只是鸩毒停滞体内多日，多少伤了她五脏六腑，虽然已经四、五天过去，她仍旧一副病容，精神也不若以往爽朗。
“如意今天请向叔过来，是有事要跟您商量。”
“请说。”孟向点头道。
“如意希望向叔回来“小莲庄”。”她照实吐露，依她身体的情况，恐怕没办法再像之前一样，在灶房一待就是一整日。所以她希望向叔回来接手，当然，她不会教他帮白忙。

“只要向叔头一点下，今后“小莲庄”收入，我们就八二分帐，每个月会我请账房跟您好好细算，绝不亏待您。”
孟向大吃一惊。“这么高的饷金……真不需要我拿出什么？”
如意摇头。
“如意看重的是向叔的手艺，还有您的人品、对客人的用心，其它事情，都可以由“小莲庄”
准备。”
这一年孟向都在外边饭馆做事，很清楚“小莲庄”现在名气，早不若以往。可就算这样，一整月少说也有千贯银子收入，这么优渥的条件，孟向当然心动，却不免怀疑——如意为什么对他这么好？
一声好还在孟向口里犹豫，突然一道黑影闯入。
“如意？！”
“大人！”如意双眼一亮，立刻自椅上站起。“您怎么会……我不是在作梦吧？”
“让我瞧瞧你。”段柯古全然没看见厅上还有其它人在，拉着她前前后后、上上下下察看了圈。
“你瘦了，瘦好多。”
“您不也一样。”她心疼地抚着他面颊。
半月未见，他变得不太一样了，原本如朝阳般爽朗的眉宇，现却添上了一抹浓浓的忧郁，想也知道这段时间，他承受了多少痛苦煎熬。
他执起她手磨蹭。他非得这样子碰她、感觉她，才能真切地体会眼前一切是真的，不是他在作梦。
午夜梦回，他多怕这一辈子再也没法这样子说话。
“我吃不下，不管我人在哪里，在做什么，我脑子里总会浮现你一个人孤单单地躺在床上……
content_en:
After sealing the envelope, he took out another piece of paper and wrote half a love poem——
Beauty is like a flower in the clouds. There is the high sky of Qingming above, and the waves of Lu River below. The journey is long and the soul is in pain, but the dream soul cannot reach Guanshan. Sauvignon Blanc is heartbreaking.
This Banque poem was written by Li Bai. Duan Kegu originally wanted to compose a few poems by himself, but as soon as he read the last two sentences, he knew that this was the feeling he wanted to express.
For him, waking up and going to sleep every day is a great torture. He looked forward to the arrival of the messenger every day, but at the same time he was also worried, fearing that the letter would contain bad news that he could not bear.
The person I care about most, how are you doing now?
He sighed quietly, then took out the letter Yu Bo had written previously, and read it slowly word for word, as if he wanted to get familiar with everything about Ruyi.
I wrote in the letter the day before yesterday that Ruyi's appearance has become much thinner. said the maid, looking as if she was about to disappear.
He closed his eyes, his face full of pain.
This must be the case, after all, she has been in a coma for more than half a month and cannot chew food. She can only feed her some rice porridge. It is difficult for her not to become haggard after all this effort.
When he left her and came to Jiangzhou alone, was this decision right or wrong?
Duan Kegu looked at the corner of the table, where there was a Kappoko inscribed by Ruyi himself. He stroked it gently with his palms, and every time he turned a page, his heart ached a little longer.
How far will God torture them before they are willing to do it? He really wanted to ask God why he was cruel enough to take it back when happiness was already right in front of him?
Does he have to suffer this torture to prove his deep love?
Thinking of this, he couldn't help but shed two lines of hot tears on his face.
"Sir." The master suddenly came and knocked on the door. "There is a letter from "Xiaolianzhuang"."
"Bring it in." Duan Kegu took a deep breath and covered his sleeves to wipe away his tears.
The master, who was about forty years old, leaned forward and walked in. He respectfully presented the letter and warned: "Sir, I have already made arrangements for your meeting with the salt merchant in the city tomorrow..."
Duan Kegu responded with a haha, not listening to what Master was saying at all.
"Hurry! Master -" he shouted quickly: "Hurry and help me prepare the car, I want to rush to Yangzhou."
The master looked surprised. "Wait a minute... Sir, what will you do with tomorrow's banquet? Your subordinates have already made arrangements with others..."
"Then the banquet will be held as long as you show up. It will take five days, no, seven days. I will go to Yangzhou for a visit and then come back." Duan Kegu ordered as he walked forward. "The government will take care of you these days."
"No, sir," the master chased after him. "This is not a problem that can be left to the lower officials to come forward... My lord, please listen to me... You really can't abandon your official duties like this. You have only been in office for a few days... My lord!"
When Master shouted for the last time, Duan Kegu had already disappeared.
Are you kidding me, having a banquet with a big businessman in the city is not as satisfying as meeting him.
Duan Kegu took out the letter and read it carefully while running. Yu Bo wrote in his letter that the capital sent a horse to deliver rhinoceros horn powder last night. After receiving it, he immediately sent someone to deliver it to "Huan Pu'an".
Yu Bo also wrote that the marriage proposal team is already on the way and will arrive in about three to five days.
Looking at the date on the letter, it was already two days ago. He couldn't wait until he received Ruyi's news tomorrow. He was going to see her now, immediately, immediately.
"Yu Liang, Yu Liang!" he shouted as he ran into the side room.
Yu Liang is Yu Bo's son. He has always helped take care of Duan Kegu in Chang'an.
"Sir." Yu Liang hurried over to obey the order.
"Pack a bag for me immediately, just bring a few clothes. Also, if my letter will arrive in the next few days, you can help me collect it first." As he said this, he took off his robe and put on a light white robe. While he was still tying his belt, Yu Liang had already packed a blue cloth bag.
"Where are you going, sir?"
"Yangzhou." He grabbed the baggage from Yu Liang's hand. "In the past few days when I'm away, you should pay more attention to me."
"Yes. Have a safe trip, sir."wind. "Yu Liang heard it from other followers and knew very well who was there in Yangzhou.
Before Liang finished speaking, Duan Kegu had already rushed out.
Even if you try to save time on eating and sleeping, it will take at least two days to get from Jiangzhou to Yangzhou.
Duan Kegu traveled all the way, surrounded by stars and moons, just to see if his sweetheart was safe and sound as soon as possible.
I wonder if the poison in her body has been cured. Can she get out of bed, walk and talk now? I wonder if Uncle Yu will forget to prepare more nourishing things for her? Uncle Yu said she had lost weight. How thin did she look like now? [hot D book@bar# unique% home & production]
A lot of questions were swirling in his mind, waiting for him to go and find out the answers in person.
He drove quickly for a day and a half, and finally arrived at "Xiaolian Village" in the evening.
The concierge of "Xiaolianzhuang" was shocked when he saw who was on the carriage. "Master Duan! "
"I'm back. "While he was speaking, people had already rushed into the open red door.
When the servants inside saw him, they welcomed him one after another. "It's Master Duan! Master Duan is back! "
When Yu Bo received the news, he rushed from the kitchen.
"Sir! Why did you come back? "
“I’ve already received the letter, how could I not come back in a hurry. "He patted Yu Bo on the shoulder. "Where is Ruyi? "
"In Shuxiang Courtyard, Miss, she is discussing things with others..."
Before Yu Bo finished speaking, Duan Kegu had already left him and ran away.
Yu Bo looked at the backs of his adults with a smile. No wonder he was anxious. After all, he hadn't seen him for half a month.
“Miss, watch your step. "
In the small courtyard of Shuxiang, the maid Shui Ying slowly helped Ruyi to sit on the main seat.
Sitting in front of her was the second cook Meng Xiang, whom she called "Uncle Xiang" back then. A year ago, "Xiaolianzhuang" changed owners, and Meng Xiang was the first to resign. He was a good cook with great persistence and superb skills.
Speaking of which, half of Ruyi's cooking skills were taught by Meng Xiang.
Seeing how weak she was, Meng Xiang couldn't help but ask: "Are you okay? I heard someone said that Lu Ming poisoned you..."
Ruyi nodded. "Thanks to Uncle Xiang for caring, Ruyi is much better. "
The rare rhinoceros horn powder rumored to be really able to detoxify poison. As soon as the horses sent by the capital arrived, Master Minghui immediately fed her and she woke up early the next morning.
It's just that the poison has been stagnating in the body for many days, which has damaged her internal organs to some extent. Although four or five days have passed, she still looks sick and her spirit is not as good as before.
"Ruyi, please invite Uncle Xiang to come over today. I have something to discuss with you. "
"Please say. "Meng Xiang nodded.
"Ruyi hopes that Uncle Xiang will come back to "Xiaolianzhuang". "She told the truth. According to her physical condition, she might not be able to stay in the kitchen for a whole day like before. So she hoped that Uncle Xiang would come back to take over. Of course, she would not teach him to help in vain.
"As long as I tell my uncle, from now on, we will divide the income of "Xiaolianzhuang" into eighty-two accounts. I will ask the accountant to calculate it carefully with you every month, and I will never treat you badly. "
Meng Xiang was shocked. "Such a high salary... really don't need me to give anything? "
Ruyi shook his head.
"What Ruyi values ​​is Uncle Xiang's craftsmanship, as well as your character and your care for the guests. Everything else can be handled by "Xiaolianzhuang"
Prepare. "
Meng Xiang was working in a restaurant this year, and he knew very well that the reputation of "Xiaolianzhuang" was not what it used to be. But even so, he could earn thousands of dollars in a month at least. With such favorable conditions, Meng Xiang was certainly moved, but he couldn't help but wonder - why was Ruyi so kind to him?
Meng Xiang was still hesitating in his mouth when a black shadow suddenly broke in.
"Ruyi? ! "
"grown ups! Ruyi's eyes lit up and she immediately stood up from the chair. "How could you... I'm not dreaming, am I?" "
"Let me see you. "Duan Kegu didn't see anyone else in the hall at all. He pulled her around and looked around.
"You've lost weight, a lot. ""Aren't you the same?" She stroked his cheek distressedly.
After not seeing him for half a month, he has become different. His eyebrows, which were originally as cheerful as the morning sun, are now filled with a deep sense of melancholy. I wonder how much pain and suffering he has endured during this period.
He took her hand and rubbed it. He had to touch her and feel her like this before he could truly realize that everything in front of him was real and that he was not dreaming.
When he came back from his dream at midnight, he was afraid that he would never be able to talk like this again in his life.
"I can't eat. No matter where I am or what I am doing, you will always appear in my mind, lying alone on the bed...
